name: cavemio-delete-workspace
title: Delete workspace
description: A danger-zone delete with a ghost: as you type the name, Boo climbs out of the workspace’s tile, and holding Delete waves him off the stage.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The name field is a real labelled input; Delete is Hold to confirm, which works with the pointer, Space and Enter, and Escape or letting go cancels it.
- A status region says when the name matches and when the workspace was deleted.
- Boo is decoration (aria-hidden) and animated: worried, waving, shy and peeking are loops of frames cut from generated animations of his own art, shipped inside boo-art.ts as WebP strips (98KB), so the install is complete; his rise, shiver, hold, peek and dive are code on top.
- One frame loop outside React moves him and sleeps when he’s still; his frames play as Web Animations. The scene is drawn at 364 × 184 and scaled to the stage.
- With reduced motion he moves in place without travelling, and the form and tile change without slides.
- Built from Hold to confirm, Input, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: The exact name
features.description: Delete stays off until the name is typed exactly; a wrong letter visibly undoes progress.

features.title: A hold, not a click
features.description: Delete has to be held (1.5s by default), so a stray click or Enter never deletes anything.

features.title: What goes with it
features.description: consequences lists what’s lost, one short line each.

features.title: A way back
features.description: With onRestore the deleted state offers Restore and says how long it’s possible.

features.title: Failures kept in place
features.description: If onDelete throws, Boo drops back into view and the button offers another hold.

features.title: Its own tile
features.description: The workspace’s logo, or its initials on its colour, is what fades and empties.

states.title: safe
states.description: The workspace’s tile under a spotlight on the lit stage; “Northwind is safe and sound”. Boo is out of sight inside it.

states.title: typing
states.description: Each matching letter springs Boo further up out of the tile (worried, hands clasped, floating), while the tile turns grey and dims; “Northwind is fading”.

states.title: wrong letter
states.description: He shivers and sinks back to the part of the name that still matches.

states.title: armed
states.description: The whole name typed: Boo is fully out, the button turns red and reads Hold to delete; “Last chance for Northwind”.

states.title: holding
states.description: He switches to waving goodbye and drifts up out of the stage over the hold, slowly at first; releasing early springs him back.

states.title: deleted
states.description: Deleting → Deleted; the tile shrinks away into an empty dashed outline, the form folds into “Northwind was deleted” with Restore, and Boo peeks up over the bottom edge.

states.title: restored
states.description: Restore: Boo dives back down into his tile, shy and blushing, the colour floods back and the form returns empty.

states.title: not deleted
states.description: If onDelete throws, the button shows the error and Hold to try again, and Boo drops back into view.
